'''Martin Schlichenmaier''' is a German-Luxembourgish mathematician whose research  deals with algebraic, geometric and analytic mathematical methods which partly have relations to theoretical and mathematical  physics.

== Life and work ==
In 1990 Schlichenmaier  earned a doctoral degree<ref name="mathtree">{{mathgenealogy|id=60836}}</ref>  in mathematics at the  [[University of Mannheim]] with  [[Rainer Weissauer]]  with the thesis ''Verallgemeinerte Krichever – Novikov Algebren und  deren Darstellungen''.<ref>{{cite thesis|title=Verallgemeinerte Krichever – Novikov Algebren und deren Darstellungen Dissertation, University of Mannheim, June 1990 |url=https://orbilu.uni.lu/handle/10993/10473|url-status=|format=|access-date=|archive-url=|last=Martin Schlichenmaier|year=1990|language=de|pages=|publisher=University of Mannheim, Mannheim, Germany |quote=}}</ref> His research topics are,  beside other fields, the geometric foundations of   quantisation,  e.g. [[Quantization (physics)|Berezin-Toeplitz-Quantisierung]] 
and infinite dimensional   [[Lie algebra]]s of geometric origin, like the algebras of Krichever- Novikov type.
<ref>[https://zbmath.org/authors/?q=ai:schlichenmaier.martin Autoren-Profil Martin Schlichenmaier] in the database  [[Zentralblatt MATH|zbMATH]]</ref>

From  1986 until  2003 he worked at the [[University of Mannheim]]. In the year 1996  he habilitated with the thesis  ''Zwei Anwendungen algebraisch-geometrischer Methoden in der theoretischen Physik: Berezin-Toeplitz-Quantisierung und globale Algebren der zweidimensionalen konformen Feldtheorie'' 
<ref>{{cite thesis|title=Zwei Anwendungen algebraisch-geometrischer Methoden in der Physik: Berezin-Toeplitz quanisierung und globale Algebren der konformen Feldtheorie, Habilitationsschrift, University of Mannheim, June 1996 |url=https://orbilu.uni.lu/handle/10993/11941|url-status=|format=|access-date=|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=Martin Schlichenmaier|year=1996|language=de|pages=|publisher=University of Mannheim, Mannheim, Germany |quote=}}</ref>

Since  2003 he has been  professor at the  [[University of Luxembourg|University of Luxemburg]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Martin Schlichenmaier|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://wwwfr.uni.lu/recherche/fstm/dmath/people/martin_schlichenmaier|url-status=|format=|access-date=|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=Université du Luxembourg|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref> recently  as  [[:wikt:Emeritus|Emeritus]] . From  2005 until  2017 he was director of the Mathematical Research Unit, Department of Mathematics
<ref>{{cite web|title=DMATH|url=https://math.uni.lu/|last= Department of Mathematics}}</ref> at the  University of  Luxemburg. He is a member of the editorial boards of the mathematical journals  ''Journal of Lie Theory'',<ref>{{cite web|title=Journal of Lie Theory|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://www.heldermann.de/JLT/jltebo.htm|url-status=|access-date=|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref> and ''Analysis and Mathematical Physics''<ref>{{cite web|title=Analysis and Mathematical Physics|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/13324/editors|url-status=|format=|access-date=|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=en|pages=|quote=}}</ref>

From 2010 until 2022 he was  president of the   Luxembourgish Mathematical Society, SML.<ref>{{cite web|title=Luxembourg Mathematical Society, Executive Board|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://math.uni.lu/sml/organisaton/executive_board.html|url-status=dead|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201227201925/https://math.uni.lu/sml/organisaton/executive_board.html|archive-date=2020-12-27|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref> He received the  Grand Prix 2016 en sciences mathematiques  de L'Institut Grand-Ducal
-prix de la Bourse de Luxembourg.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.igdss.lu/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/Conf%C3%A9rences-donn%C3%A9es-de-2008-%C3%A0-2018.pdf | title=La Section des Sciences de l'Institut Grand-ducal accueille des conférenciers étrangers et luxembourgeois entre 2008 et 2018 | language=fr | trans-title=The Science Section of the Grand-Ducal Institute welcomes foreign and Luxembourgish speakers between 2008 and 2018}}</ref>  2019 he was appointed as full member of the  [[Grand Ducal Institute|Institut Grand-Ducal]], Section des Sciences<ref>{{cite web|title=INSTITUT GRAND-DUCAL {{!}} Section des sciences|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://www.igdss.lu/membres/|url-status=|format=|access-date=|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref>
